# Livil

> Livil (Livil Music) is a social music app for independent artists and the people who listen to them. Listen with friends in real time (Jam), share and repost songs (from Livil or Spotify), chat, and discover artists through people you know. Free on the App Store, Google Play and the web at https://livil-music.com.

## Livil music score

The Livil music score is the number shown under a person's @name on their Livil profile, next to a small round pulse badge. On Livil, "music score" means this activity score, not sheet music. It is recalculated every night from everything the person has done on Livil, with daily limits.

How the Livil music score is calculated (points per action):

- Listen to a song: +1 (once per song a day, up to 50 a day; Livil songs played, or Spotify songs opened)
- Like a post: +1
- Comment: +2 (up to 20 a day)
- Share a song in chat: +2 (up to 10 a day)
- Repost a song: +5 (once per song, up to 10 a day)
- Host a Jam that played 5+ minutes: +5 (up to 3 a day)
- Upload your own song: +25 (published songs only, up to 3 a day)
- Someone plays your upload: +1 (once per listener per song a day)
- Someone likes your repost: +1 (up to 50 a day)
- Someone comments on your repost: +2 (once per person per repost, up to 25 people a day)

Liking or playing your own posts earns nothing. Undoing something (unliking, deleting a comment or repost, a song taken down) removes its points. The score is visible to anyone signed in to Livil, except people the person has blocked.

- [How the Livil music score is calculated](https://livil-music.com/score): the full points list and FAQ
